defects.title: Session join fails with 401 Unauthorized (Authentication required)
defects.description: Clicking Join Now in Pre-join preview sends POST /api/v1/sessions/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/participants without an authenticated session/principal, causing backend to reject with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
reproduction_steps: Click Join Now and observe HTTP 401 Unauthorized response
defects.required_correction: Establish/provide authenticated principal context for session join or align frontend/backend auth flow so joining a session succeeds.
